body:
Designs can use a default palette of components built into Solace, so a screen shows real controls rather than empty boxes.

### Do

- Agree the palette with the human before building it. A cursory suggestion, not a prescription: text, heading, button, text input, and an image placeholder.
- Add each component to the validator's table with its own properties, such as a button's label.
- Draw each in the renderer with Lustre.
- Keep adding a component to one entry in each place, so the palette can grow.

### Acceptance

- Tests: each component validates, an unknown property on one is refused, each draws with its `data-design-id`, and a component can't hold children unless its type allows them.

### Left out

Attachments such as raster and SVG images, and a project's own component library as the palette.
title: ui: default components
